mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized signals robust economic momentum that directly translates to higher corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong job growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% monthly) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicate a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint market behavior.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-constrained regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) indicates worsening manufacturing capacity that increases input costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without specific triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates an exceptionally tight labor market that fuels consumer spending growth and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 0.8%) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 4.0%) indicates sustainable economic expansion without inflationary pressures, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint market dynamics.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS growth > 0.8% and CPIAUCSL < 4.0% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts (HOUST) above 1500.0 thousand units signal strengthening consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where HOUST > 1500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
